messages:
alex.k: taking over primary for the 18:00-02:00 UTC shift — quick perms/access check before i go fully live. i need PD escalation, AWS console access for the eu-prod account, and Grafana edit/view on the infra dashboards. also need runbook links for latency and OOM alerts.
sam: handing off — checklist: PD -> you should be on the 'infra-oncall' PD escalation policy as Responder, not just observer. i added you this morning but double-check.

sam: AWS -> you need to be able to assume role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall-EU. confirm with `aws sts get-caller-identity` after assume-role.

sam: Grafana -> org role 'Editor' on org id 7 should be enough to ack alerts and modify dashboards. if you only have Viewer, you can't silence alerts.

alex.k: got it. @tina you are secondary for the night, can you confirm you have PD responder and assume-role perms? there is a coverage gap for APAC windows 01:00-04:00 UTC if anything spikes, call me + the infra rotation.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: schedule "infra-oncall" rotated — primary: alex.k, secondary: tina. Escalation policy: infra-oncall.

incident-bot: Incident bot: runbook "latency-spike" pinned to channel. link: https://runbooks.redwood/infrastructure/latency-spike

liam: quick note on AWS: if you use SSO, do `aws sso login --profile redwood-eu` then `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall-EU --role-session-name oncall-session`. you get temporary creds for 1h by default.

alex.k: copying the exact commands here so folks can paste:```bash
# login
aws sso login --profile redwood-eu
# assume role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall-EU --role-session-name oncall-alex
```

sam: Grafana tip: if you need to silence an alert rule quickly, open the panel -> Alert -> Mute -> add a 30m mute and a note. if you can't Mute, you'll see a 403 due to role.

alex.k: confirming i can see infra dashboards and mute alerts. i can assume the role but got a warning about missing kms:Decrypt on a helper role — anything I need to file?

sam: that sounds like the log-archiver role. you don't need Decrypt for basic paging. file a ticket to eng-infra for the KMS perms if you need to fetch archived S3 objects. not blocking for tonight.

alex.k: OK filing later. @tina please verify your PD access — steps: 1) go to https://redwood.pagerduty.com -> Services -> infra-oncall -> People -> confirm role Responder. 2) check your notification rules.

tina: verified — i'm Responder and my phone notifications are on. i also tested `aws sso login` and can assume the EU role. Grafana says Editor. :thumbsup:

alex.k: good. a few runbook pointers for whoever gets paged: - latency-spike runbook (link above) - oom-and-crash runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/infrastructure/oom-crash - fallback model endpoint: https://console.redwood/models/fallback (useful if model-serving nodes in eu-prod are unhealthy)

alex.k: lightweight checklist i'm leaving in the thread for future handoffs: 1) PD: confirm Responder + notification rules 2) AWS: `aws sso login` + assume-role to Redund-Oncall-EU 3) Grafana: Editor role on org 7 4) Okta MFA active 5) Runbooks bookmarked and pinned 6) Contact list (pager, slack, phone) 7) Check scheduled maintenance windows for the shift 

sam: small correction to checklist line 2 -> role name is RedwooD-Oncall-EU? jk. seriously: role is RedwooD-Oncall-EU vs Redwood-Oncall-EU — i'll add exact ARN to the runbook to avoid typos.

liam: also recommend a quick smoke check after handoff: hit health endpoint `https://eu-prod.redwood/health` and run a short gen against fallback model: `curl -s -X POST https://eu-api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"health check"}'` to confirm latencies are normal. put the timing in the handoff note if anything > 500ms.

alex.k: ran those checks — health 200, fallback generation ~220ms. leaving note in PagerDuty incident message if anything changes.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledgement recorded by alex.k for test-alert #4692.

alex.k: last item: if you can't access something, use the emergency access on-call support flow in the runbook (link above) to request temporary elevation from eng-infra. that flow requires an approval from a senior infra engineer — tag @sam or @liam.

tina: noted. thanks for the handoff. i'll shadow for first 30min.

alex.k: thanks all — i'm online and will take any pages. ping me in thread and call if urgent. :phone:
